main.description: Audit record for an agent-led deploy stage. Written by the agent after each `e7m actor deploy --only <stage>` step completes. Per ADR-2605232000. Public record — carries no PHI, only DIDs + target NSIDs + outcome + L2-anchor-pending-seq.

stewardDid.description: DID of the human Steward who issued the capability authorizing this deploy

capabilityUri.description: AT URI of the parent consent capability (purpose=deploy-execution)

agentTokenJwsHash.description: SHA-256 of the JWS used for this specific call (correlates to com.etzhayyim.deploy.agentToken.jwsHash)

nsid.description: e.g. deploy.cfWorker / deploy.k8s.deployment / deploy.k8s.service / deploy.pages / deploy.docker.image

identifier.description: Concrete resource name (e.g. karute-did-web / lg-karute / karute-pages / ghcr.io/etzhayyim/lg-karute)

command.description: Sanitized command executed (no secrets); e.g. 'wrangler deploy' / 'kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml'

commitSha.description: git commit the deploy was built from

keyId.description: DID-doc verification method id of agentDid
